items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: What else do you remember about the broadcast with Paul Whiteman. -- The only thing that stood out in my mind was it was such a big band they had there and then the three of us.

ctx.x: just about ready to come out.
Do you remember much about the musician's union recording ban?
No, I don't remember anything about that, nope.
